newsitem.title: USA: U.S. December T-bond futures end strongly higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. December T-bond futures end strongly higher.

text.p: Oct 2 - U.S. December T-bonds posted a session of strong gains, touching a six-week high during the day as bullish momentum continued. Traders said one dealer was a buyer of at least 6,000 Dec contracts during the session. Trade turned light in the afternoon, and traders predicted sideways, quiet action heading into Friday's key September employment report. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
